newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-OSCAR ROBERTSON DONATES KIDNEY TO AILING DAUGHTER.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-OSCAR ROBERTSON DONATES KIDNEY TO AILING DAUGHTER.

text.p: Basketball legend Oscar Robertson on Thursday donated a kidney to his ailing 33-year-old daughter Tia.
University Hospital officials said that both the 58-year-old Hall of Famer and his daughter came through the surgery in good condition.
The daughter is afflicted with lupus, a chronic disease which affects internal organs.
Dr Roy First, who headed the surgical team, said Robertson was in good spirits and "very relieved that all went well."

Robertson, considered one of the greatest guards ever to play the game, enjoyed a stellar career at the University of Cincinnati and with the National Basketball Association's Cincinnati Royals and Milwaukee Bucks.
In recent years, Robertson, known as "The Big O" during his playing days, has been a prominent business and civic leader in the Cincinnati area.
Bob Huggins, current University of Cincinnati basketball coach, said the kidney donation was a prime example of Robertson's generous and selfless nature.
Even with only one kidney, Huggins said, Robertson still has "one of the biggest hearts you'll find anywhere."
